proof: For ordered vertices A,B,C,D, consecutive midpoint differences are (C-A)/2 and (D-B)/2; the opposite midpoint differences are the same vectors. The half-scale triangle construction proves this geometrically, including the shown concave example.

checks.scaling_is_explicit: Similarity is used here, not a claim of equal area.

limits: Numerical checks supplement the stated general proof. No audience learning is inferred.
